## 1. Open Studio on the Knowledge pillar

Knowledge is where everything forge has learned lives, as graphs it can read back.

![Open Studio on the Knowledge pillar](/media/stories/S6/01-open-studio-on-the-knowledge-pillar.png)

## 2. Press "+ New KB"

One form, and the only two things that matter on it are what this knowledge base is called and what it is bound to.

![Press "+ New KB"](/media/stories/S6/02-press-new-kb.png)

## 3. Name it, bind it to the forge-develop flow, scope it to the review-band, and create it

Binding is the act.

![Name it, bind it to the forge-develop flow, scope it to the review-band, and create it](/media/stories/S6/03-name-it-bind-it-to-the-forge-develop-flo.png)

## 4. Follow the seeding session forge started for it

Creating a knowledge base starts an agent that fills it.

![Follow the seeding session forge started for it](/media/stories/S6/04-follow-the-seeding-session-forge-started.png)

## 5. Brief the seeding agent on what this knowledge base is for, and let it read

A band-scoped knowledge base has no project repo to read — it reads the Flow’s own archived cycles, and synthesises what review kept finding.

![Brief the seeding agent on what this knowledge base is for, and let it read](/media/stories/S6/05-brief-the-seeding-agent-on-what-this-kno.png)

## 6. Read the themes it drafted and approve them into the knowledge base

Nothing an agent drafts enters the brain without a human saying yes.

![Read the themes it drafted and approve them into the knowledge base](/media/stories/S6/06-read-the-themes-it-drafted-and-approve-t.png)

## 7. Back on the knowledge base, find a real theme in the graph

Seeded means there is something in it.

![Back on the knowledge base, find a real theme in the graph](/media/stories/S6/07-back-on-the-knowledge-base-find-a-real-t.png)

## 8. Go to the Projects pillar to find the project on the other end of that binding

A knowledge base is bound to a Flow, and a Flow runs against projects.

![Go to the Projects pillar to find the project on the other end of that binding](/media/stories/S6/08-go-to-the-projects-pillar-to-find-the-pr.png)

## 9. Open story-s6

story-s6 is provisioned from the node-library fixture for this run, so it is the project a clean checkout can plan against.

![Open story-s6](/media/stories/S6/09-open-story-s6.png)

## 10. Press "Architect →" to plan a piece of work on it

A knowledge base earns its keep at planning time.

![Press "Architect →" to plan a piece of work on it](/media/stories/S6/10-press-architect-to-plan-a-piece-of-work-.png)

## 11. Describe the work, cap what this run may spend, and press "Start architect"

The planner is a real agent and a real agent costs money, so the operator caps this run before starting it.

![Describe the work, cap what this run may spend, and press "Start architect"](/media/stories/S6/11-describe-the-work-cap-what-this-run-may-.png)

## 12. Open the architect session it just started

What happens next is the thing S6 exists to prove.

![Open the architect session it just started](/media/stories/S6/12-open-the-architect-session-it-just-start.png)

## 13. Go back to the knowledge base and see that the planner actually read it — the brain-index event, naming this KB and what it took

This is the beat the whole product rests on.

![Go back to the knowledge base and see that the planner actually read it — the brain-index event, naming this KB and what it took](/media/stories/S6/13-go-back-to-the-knowledge-base-and-see-th.png)

## 14. Open the knowledge base’s Health tab and drain it to green

A seeded knowledge base is not a healthy one.

![Open the knowledge base’s Health tab and drain it to green](/media/stories/S6/14-open-the-knowledge-base-s-health-tab-and.png)

## 15. Read the diff the drain proposes, file by file, before accepting it

This is where S6 ends: a rendered diff, per file, of what an agent changed inside the operator’s knowledge — not a claim that it cleared N findings.

![Read the diff the drain proposes, file by file, before accepting it](/media/stories/S6/15-read-the-diff-the-drain-proposes-file-by.png)
